entries.intro: Tus necesidades cambian durante el día: comida, turismo, hogar, tecnología o servicios profesionales. ConectaProIA te ayuda a buscar contactos según tu necesidad y comuna. La cobertura y las condiciones se confirman con cada prestador.
entries.feed_prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create one polished 4:5 Instagram Feed ad for ConectaProIA, a Chilean contact directory. Fresh professional 3D paper cut collage around a generic green smartphone directory: appetizing meal, suitcase and mountain postcard, paint roller, notebook computer, briefcase. Equal emphasis across sectors, cream forest green vivid amber and turquoise, balanced large type, no real UI or fabricated search results. Exact headline: 'Las amarillas de tu día a día.'. Exact secondary line: 'Comida · Turismo · Hogar · Tecnología · Profesionales'. Brand 'ConectaProIA'. Required text: 'Cuéntanos qué necesitas y tu comuna.', 'WhatsApp +56 9 8343 4503', 'conectaproia.cl', 'Buscar contactos es gratis.', 'El servicio lo cobra cada prestador. Confirma disponibilidad y valores.' Premium diverse advertising art direction and clear mobile typography. Correct Spanish accents and complete words. Contact block large. No testimonials, fabricated promotions, verification, guaranteed geographic coverage or immediate availability. Keep substantial margins. No additional text.
